The default settings are "AMATEUR" speed against the computer on "EASY" difficulty with "AIM ASSIST" enabled (this gives you a little help with shot accuracy). Once you feel comfortable, try the other difficulties, "PROFFESSIONAL" speed, then…

games.title: Cavern of Gears
games.description: Cavern of Gears is a 2D action-adventure set in a steampunk underworld. Fight through gear-driven caverns with a growing arsenal of weapons, uncover the fate of the workers who vanished below, and face down the powers that took their place.
games.howTo: Fight your way through caverns, defeating enemies and collecting weapons and power-ups as you travel deeper. Clear all the stages and the bosses to discover the century-old secret that they are hiding. WASD to move, SHIFT to dash, J/K to attack, R to switch weapon, L to use power-up

games.title: Fit in the Wall

games.howTo: Score as much as you can by adjusting the yellow cube to fit in the pattern. Desktop: Use arrow keys to move the yellow cube Mobile: Tp on left and right side of screen to move the yellow cube in that direction.

games.title: Ball Jump Switch The Colors
games.description: Tap on the screen, that will make the ball bounce higher and higher. The ball has one color, and can pass through obstacle with the same color, or sneak in between obstacles with different colors.

Guide your colorful ball upward, timing your jumps perfectly to pass through rotating barriers and collect stars to switch colors on the fly! games.title: Orbital
games.description: Orbital is a fast reflex game. Rings close in on the glowing core from every side, and you steer a spark around it to slip through the gaps. Crystals appear in the riskiest openings: grab them in a row to build your combo. Survive to earn stars and unlock new…
games.howTo: - Move: Left / Right arrow keys, A / D, or left / right mouse button - Focus (slow time, after upgrade): Shift - Mobile: touch and hold the left or right half of the screen; two fingers for focus - Retry: Space, Menu: Esc, Mute: M

games.title: Bridge
games.description: BRIDGE is a stylish, minimalist physics platformer and timing runner where precision and composure are everything.
games.howTo: Goal: Build a bridge just long enough to reach the next pillar. If the bridge is too short or too long, it will tumble into the abyss! Aim for the red center dot for bonus shards and combo multipliers. Controls: Mobile & Tablet: Tap and hold anywhere on the screen to extend the bridge release to drop it. games.title: Egg Empire
games.description: Egg Empire is a cozy 3D idle tycoon about growing a chicken farm into an egg empire. Buy hens, collect the eggs they lay, sell them at the stall and merge hens into rarer breeds that lay pricier eggs.
games.howTo: Desktop: - WASD or arrow keys: move - Space: jump - Right mouse button (hold and drag): turn the camera - Mouse wheel: zoom - E: pet the dog - R: back to the start Mobile: - Joystick (bottom left): move - Jump button (bottom right): jump - Drag on the screen: turn the camera
